spans.s:
केव् केव्, cl. 1. A. केवते, -वितुम्, to
serve, attend to.
केवट केवट, अस्, m., Ved. a cave, a hollow.

केवर्त केवर्त, अस्, m., Ved. a fisherman,
= कैवर्त, q. v.

केवल केवल, अस्, आ (or Ved. ई), अम्, ex-
clusively one's own (not common to others); peculiar;
alone, only, mere, sole, one, excluding others; not
connected with anything else, isolated, abstract, abso-
lute; simple, pure, uncompounded, unmingled, perfect
in one's self, entire, whole, all; selfish, envious;
(अम्), ind. only, merely, solely, entirely, wholly,
absolutely, certainly; न केवलम् — अपि, not only —
but also; केवलम् — न तु, only — but not; (अस्), m.,
N. of a prince, a son of Nara; (ई), f. the doctrine of
the absolute unity of spirit; N. of a place; (अम्),
n. the doctrine of the absolute unity of spirit; N. of
a country.
—केवल-ज्ञानिन्, ई, m., N. of the first
Arhat of the last Utsarpiṇī.
—केवल-तस्, ind. only.
—केवल-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being alone.
—केवल-द्रव्य, अम्, n. black pepper.
—केवल-
नैयायिक, अस्, m. a mere logician, not versed in
any other science.
—केवल-वैयाकरण, अस्, m.
a mere grammarian, one not versed in any other
science.
—केवलाघ (˚ल-अघ), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
alone guilty.
—केवलात्मन् (˚ल-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, one
whose nature or essence is absolute unity.
—केवला-
दिन् (˚ल-आद्˚), ई, इनी, इ, eating by one's self alone
or apart from others.

केवलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, alone, one, only; devoted to
the doctrine of the absolute unity of spirit; (ई), m.
with Jainas, an Arhat.

केविका केविका or केवी, f., N. of a flower,
= कविका, commonly केवेर.
